title: Autonomous Navigation Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Mapping, localization, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and performance measures. The Autonomous Navigation Database documents how robots find their way: building maps, figuring out where they are in them (localization), planning paths, avoiding obstacles, and measuring how well it all works. From warehouse robots to planetary rovers, navigation is the same stack — sense, map, localize, plan, move — and each record covers the full stack with the performance numbers that prove it.

title: Autonomous Navigation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Stack: MAPPING (occupancy grids: P(occupied|measurements) via log-odds updates; SLAM: jointly estimate map + pose — EKF, particle filter, graph optimization); LOCALIZATION (Bayes filter: predict with motion model, update with sensor model; AMCL particle filters; convergence = particle spread below threshold); PLANNING global (A*: f(n)=g(n)+h(n) on grids/graphs; RRT for high-DOF: sample, steer, connect); PLANNING local/trajectory (dynamic window: admissible velocities given acceleration limits; trajectory optimization); AVOIDANCE (reactive: potential fields; predictive: velocity obstacles, account for obstacle motion). Metrics: success rate, path-length ratio vs optimal, localization RMSE, planning time, replanning frequency. Failure modes: localization loss (kidnapped robot), local minima in potential fields, dynamic obstacles faster than the planner.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

title: Autonomous Navigation Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: A* test (paths optimal on test grids); filter test (localization converges with enough particles); metrics test (scores match hand computation); determinism test (seeded sims reproduce). Limitations: 2D demos; real SLAM needs real sensors; dynamic avoidance needs timing analysis. Every stack record states its test environment and trial count.

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
